summary: A small task from a blank file that mixes the week: a token counter, the knowledge base loader and a price per million tokens (an example price). You estimate the cost of pasting everything into every prompt, scale it to real size, and compare with sending only the best 3 documents.
goal: Count the tokens of every document, estimate the cost of sending them, and explain why pasting everything breaks at real size.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then read the contract
Step 1: write cost.py and see mypy say Success
Step 2: write cost_report.py and match the four lines, then predict 10,000 questions
Step 3: write two tests and see 2 passed, then call estimate_cost with a string and read the error
Step 4: work out tokens and cost at 1,000 times the size, and compare with the best 3 documents
Play the Cost Check game to the end and see your score
